ex.en: This phone case is known for its durability.
ex.zh: 這款手機殼以耐用著稱。

ex.en: We tested the durability of the material.
ex.zh: 我們測試了這種材料的耐用度。

ex.en: Please stay seated for the duration of the flight.
ex.zh: 飛行全程請留在座位上。

ex.en: The duration of the contract is two years.
ex.zh: 合約期限為兩年。

ex.en: The coffee enabled me to stay awake during the dull concert.
ex.zh: 咖啡讓我在無聊的音樂會上保持清醒。

ex.en: I used to feel it dull.
ex.zh: 我以前覺得這很無聊。

ex.en: The meeting was long and dull.
ex.zh: 這場會議又長又無聊。

ex.en: The point of the pencil has become dull.
ex.zh: 鉛筆的筆尖鈍了。

ex.en: My knife has become dull.
ex.zh: 我的刀變鈍了。

ex.en: It was a dull, gray morning.
ex.zh: 那是個陰沉灰暗的早晨。

ex.en: The paint looks dull after many years.
ex.zh: 油漆過了很多年看起來很暗淡。

ex.en: Someone dumped trash by the river.
ex.zh: 有人把垃圾丟在河邊。

ex.en: Don't just dump your bags on the floor.
ex.zh: 別把包包隨便丟在地上。

ex.en: We all wondered why she had dumped such a nice man.
ex.zh: 我們都不懂她為什麼要甩掉那麼好的男人。

ex.en: My girlfriend dumped me.
ex.zh: 我女朋友甩了我。

ex.en: Is Tom going to dump Mary?
ex.zh: 湯姆要跟瑪麗分手嗎？

ex.en: The company was accused of dumping cheap steel overseas.
ex.zh: 這家公司被指控在海外傾銷廉價鋼鐵。

ex.en: Dumping goods below cost is illegal.
ex.zh: 以低於成本的價格傾銷商品是違法的。

ex.en: We took the old sofa to the dump.
ex.zh: 我們把舊沙發載到垃圾場。

ex.en: This room is a dump!
ex.zh: 這房間簡直像垃圾堆！

ex.en: Microsoft recently unveiled two new dual screen devices.
ex.zh: 微軟最近推出了兩款新的雙螢幕裝置。

ex.en: She has dual citizenship.
ex.zh: 她有雙重國籍。

ex.en: This room serves a dual purpose as an office and a guest room.
ex.zh: 這個房間兼具辦公室和客房兩種用途。

ex.en: The contract was duly signed by both parties.
ex.zh: 合約已由雙方正式簽署。

ex.en: Your application has been duly received.
ex.zh: 您的申請已妥善收到。

ex.en: The package duly arrived on Monday.
ex.zh: 包裹如期在星期一送達。

ex.en: She promised to call, and she duly did.
ex.zh: 她答應會打電話，後來果然打了。

ex.en: The movie was dubbed into Mandarin.
ex.zh: 這部電影被配成了國語。

ex.en: Do you prefer dubbed or subtitled films?
ex.zh: 你比較喜歡配音版還是字幕版的電影？

ex.en: There are so many mistakes in this book that the teacher has dubbed it "The Drunkard's Edition".
ex.zh: 這本書錯誤多到老師稱它為「醉鬼版」。

ex.en: The press dubbed him "the king of startups."
ex.zh: 媒體封他為「新創之王」。

ex.en: The firm went under due to lack of capital.
ex.zh: 公司因缺乏資金而倒閉。

ex.en: The baseball game was called off due to rain.
ex.zh: 棒球比賽因雨取消了。

ex.en: Due to the worsening weather, the departure was delayed.
ex.zh: 由於天氣變差，出發延後了。

ex.en: The rent is due on the first of the month.
ex.zh: 房租每月一號到期。

ex.en: When is the report due?
ex.zh: 報告什麼時候要交？

ex.en: The train is due to arrive at 3 p.m.
ex.zh: 火車預定下午三點抵達。

ex.en: Her baby is due in May.
ex.zh: 她的預產期在五月。

ex.en: Cross off the names of the people who have paid their dues.
ex.zh: 請把已經繳費的人名字劃掉。

ex.en: Members pay their dues every year.
ex.zh: 會員每年繳會費。

ex.en: It is the students' duty to clean their classrooms.
ex.zh: 打掃教室是學生的責任。

ex.en: I believe it my duty to protect these children.
ex.zh: 我認為保護這些孩子是我的責任。

ex.en: She performed her duties.
ex.zh: 她盡了自己的職責。

ex.en: My duties include answering phones and scheduling meetings.
ex.zh: 我的職務包括接電話和安排會議。

ex.en: You have to pay duty on imported goods.
ex.zh: 進口商品必須繳關稅。

ex.en: Import duties on cars are very high here.
ex.zh: 這裡汽車的進口關稅很高。

duty.zh: on duty / off duty：值班中／下班、不值班

ex.en: Which doctor is on duty tonight?
ex.zh: 今晚是哪位醫生值班？

ex.en: The security guard is off duty now.
ex.zh: 那位警衛現在已經下班了。

ex.en: All the furniture was covered with dust.
ex.zh: 所有家具都積滿了灰塵。

ex.en: Probably you are allergic to pollen or dust.
ex.zh: 你可能對花粉或灰塵過敏。

ex.en: Dust got into one of my eyes.
ex.zh: 灰塵跑進了我的一隻眼睛。

ex.en: She dusts the furniture every day.
ex.zh: 她每天擦家具上的灰塵。

ex.en: Please dust the shelves before the guests arrive.
ex.zh: 客人來之前請把架子上的灰塵擦乾淨。

ex.en: That's a dumb question.
ex.zh: 這是一個愚蠢的問題。

ex.en: I think you're dumb.
ex.zh: 我認為你傻。

ex.en: The world is full of dumb people.
ex.zh: 世界上都是白痴。

ex.en: Helen Keller was blind, deaf and dumb.
ex.zh: 海倫凱勒眼盲，耳聾，又啞。

ex.en: She was blind, deaf, and dumb.
ex.zh: 她又盲又聾又啞。

ex.en: Tom got a computer virus while he was watching videos on dubious Internet sites.
ex.zh: 湯姆在可疑的網站上看影片的時候中了電腦病毒。

ex.en: He made a dubious claim that nobody could verify.
ex.zh: 他提出了一個沒人能證實的可疑說法。

ex.en: This contract is made in duplicate.
ex.zh: 本合約一式兩份。

ex.en: I lost my key, so I had a duplicate made.
ex.zh: 我弄丟了鑰匙，所以去打了一把備份。

ex.en: Don't duplicate work that someone else has already done.
ex.zh: 別重複做別人已經做過的工作。

ex.en: The results could not be duplicated.
ex.zh: 這些結果無法再次重現。

ex.en: These boots are durable and waterproof.
ex.zh: 這雙靴子耐穿又防水。

ex.en: We need a durable material for the outdoor tables.
ex.zh: 戶外桌子需要用耐用的材質。

ex.en: The buyer completed due diligence before signing.
ex.zh: 買方在簽約前完成了盡職調查。

ex.en: Our legal team is conducting due diligence on the supplier.
ex.zh: 我們的法務團隊正在對供應商進行盡職調查。

ex.en: The inquiry examined allegations of steel dumping.
ex.zh: 這項調查檢視了鋼材傾銷的指控。

ex.en: Import duties were imposed to prevent dumping.
ex.zh: 政府課徵進口關稅以防止傾銷。

ex.en: They bought a duplex and rented out the other unit.
ex.zh: 他們買了一棟雙拼住宅，並把另一戶出租。

ex.en: The duplex has separate entrances for both families.
ex.zh: 這棟複式住宅有兩個獨立出入口，供兩戶家庭使用。

ex.en: Is this a duty-free shop?
ex.zh: 這是免稅店嗎？

ex.en: I bought some duty-free chocolate at the airport.
ex.zh: 我在機場買了一些免稅巧克力。
